definition: Bring an existing drawing in as a plan record: lay a scanned plan behind the grid, trace its rooms, and supply what a drawing cannot state. Every gap is named, and the record cannot leave until none remain.
basis: Editorial. docs/ingestion.md: "A drawing goes in; a record comes out." A scanned drawing is loaded "as a backdrop (it stays in the browser — never uploaded)", each room "then needs what a drawing cannot state", and the "completeness panel names every gap" before the record may leave. Its discipline: "a human makes every judgment; extraction only ever proposes."

surface.what: Turn an existing drawing into a plan record, with every gap named.
read: The scanned drawing stays in your browser and is never uploaded.
Trace each room as a rectangle, then give it a type, its windows and doors, and its level.
Or start from a drafter's CAD file: its closed outlines arrive as proposed rooms, never as decisions.
Once nothing is missing, check the record, send it to the bench, or download it.
